newsitem.title: USA: Westmark to spin off units as dividend.
newsitem.headline: Westmark to spin off units as dividend.

text.p: Westmark Group Holdings Inc said Thursday that part of its subsidiary, Green World Technologies Inc, will be spun off as a shareholder dividend within the next few months.
Green World makes the Talon Refrigerant Management System, which is an add-on to existing air conditioning equipment that conserves energy, said the company.

In December, Westmark said it received an unsolicited letter of intent to purchase Green World from a New York/Florida-based investment banking firm. The company said it has decided that shareholders will be better served and will gain value by spinning off a portion of the subsidiary and financing the company as a separate entity.

The company expects that Green World will become a public entity and will seek listing on Nasdaq. It added that a spinoff will enhance shareholder value and allow management to concentrate on its core non-conforming mortgage banking business.
